slides.text: Socrates Questions Can Reduce LLM Hallucinations Socrates (470–399 BC) Greece, Athens the founder of Western philosophy Plato ( 428-348 BC) Greece, Athens philosopher Aristotle (384–322 BC) Greece, Athens philosopher LLM can reduce hallucinations via Socratic self-questioning using simple specific focused questions. It gets expensive if using cloud-based services, because you end up submitting 10 questions instead of 1 . This is one more reason for running your models locally on your own hardware.
